preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 300,000.
The number of edges m must be between n-1 and the minimum of 300,000 and the maximum possible edges in a graph with n vertices.
The number of special vertices k must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= n for v_i in special_vertices)
preconditions.description: All special vertices must be within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= c_i <= 10**9 for c_i in c_values)
preconditions.description: All coin values c_i must be non-negative and up to 1 billion.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= w_i <= 10**9 for w_i in w_values)
preconditions.description: All weights w_i must be non-negative and up to 1 billion.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n and x_i != y_i for x_i, y_i in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers, one for each vertex.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(profit, int) for profit in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value must be an integer representing the maximum profit for making the corresponding vertex saturated.
Each profit value must be non-negative.
